name: Linear
author: Linear Oy

sections.description:
This plugin requires the use of 3rd party service i.e., Linear.fi services in order to work. Plugin acts as an interface for linear.fi real estate CRM and it provides functionality to display company listings on your own WordPress site.

With this plugin you can add archive of your listings on any WordPress page without manually duplicating the content from your real estate management system on your WordPress page. Just configure the plugin in the settings page and everything will be done for you.
The User is responsible for installing the plugin and is liable for any direct or indirect expenses to themself caused by using the plugin.
Linear is not responsible if any problems occur and is not responsible to fix or develop the plugin. Users may use the plugin at their own discretion.

If you used this plugin previously before the 3.X.X update, you need to request new API-credentials.
sections.installation:
To install plugin:
1. Upload plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it through WordPress dashboard.
2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
3. Go to ‘Linear’ settings page in admin dashboard and fill the necessary values and select your dynamic page(s) for the content. If you don’t have the necessary values for the settings, please contact Linear customer support.
4. If you added correct data to settings page, listings for your company from Linear real estate system should be working.
sections.faq:
Which page should I set to be as the dynamic parent page?

Most often this page is called “Apartments” or similar, and this plugin would then show all the listings on that page, and also use that same page for single listing content.

I have a Gutenberg website, does it support your plugin?

Yes! In the plugin settings you can choose which way to render the plugin content, and we have a setting for Gutenberg sites if you prefer to have the content be shown inside another block or group.

My website uses Elementor, can I use this plugin?

Most likely yes! Unless you have a custom setup, the plugin should work directly as-is, but if you cannot get anything to show up, change the render method to “shortcode” and use the shortcode in the instructions in the set dynamic parent page.

I cannot see any listings, what’s wrong?

First off, do you have public listings in Linear? If so, please check the settings that you have se the dynamic parent pages for every language, and if that doesn’t help, you can also re-save the permalinks. If you still cannot see your listings, please contact Linear support and we’ll be happy to help!

My site uses a multilang plugin like Polylang, WPML or Translatepress, does this affect the plugin behaviour in any way?

If you use multiple languages on your site, it would be good to set a dynamic parent page for each of the languages, there should be a field in the Linear plugin settings for each language. The plugin itself tries to show the listings content(s) in the selected language, as long as it is a available language in the Linear CRM.

The ‘Listing’ page seems too thin, how can I change this?

Our plugin tries to stay avay from deciding how your pages should look like and tried to inherit styles from the used WordPress theme. By default, the plugin content is rendered in the the_content() position, but if you want to have this be rendered in some place else eg. inside a wider wrapper, you can use either the “Gutenberg” or “Shortcode” render option, and have more controll over the final position where the listings are shown.
